_README: Minimal name-collision fixture: two @Service classes both define process(); CheckoutController.view() calls orderService.process() only. Authored from source. Its purpose is to MEASURE the HIGH-3 DI-resolution gap — see _di_resolution_note.
_di_resolution_note: KNOWN GAP this harness measures: the receiver of orderService.process() is the field `orderService` of declared type OrderService, so the call must resolve to OrderService.process ONLY. Short-name resolution instead fans out to PaymentService.process too (a false edge). di_resolution scores 1.0 only when NO forbidden edge is emitted; it is 0.0 today and rises to 1.0 when HIGH-3 (DI/receiver-type resolution) lands. Baseline-guarded, not a hard target.
